name: Torba

attributes.attribute: the subject of a fuller record

sources: Monaghan, Patricia. The Encyclopedia of Celtic Mythology and Folklore. Checkmark Books, 2008.
text: Torba is a cross reference in the old book of lore. The name sends the reader to a fuller record. That record holds the life of a hero's house. Torba names only the link, and it adds no new tale. Seek the longer page for the whole history and keep this one brief.

okr.objective: Note the cross reference of Torba.
key_results: It links to a fuller record
It names the hero's mother only
